name: overview_paragraph
text: **Aegis** is a closed-loop, AI-driven Kubernetes orchestration research system that couples multi-horizon quantile workload forecasting (LightGBM $p_{10}, p_{50}, p_{90}$) with joint constraint optimization (OR-Tools CP-SAT) and a custom Go scheduler plugin. It scales replica counts proactively, packs pods onto energy-efficient nodes, and power-manages idle infrastructure ahead of demand shifts, under hard safety guards (dead zone, cooldown, minimum active nodes). Its empirical claims in this README come from one frozen trace-replay simulator evaluated on the Azure Functions 2019 production serverless trace.
